## FOR LOCAL DEVELOPMENT ONLY
services:
  # modeling a functional datadog agent
  datadog-agent:
    image: gcr.io/datadoghq/agent:7
    container_name: datadog-agent
    env_file:
      # Loading secret from *.env refer to envs/ and use `make inject-env-locally`
      # to generate .env from envs/*.env
      # ex: DD_API_KEY
      - .env
    environment:
      # Non-secret configuration
      - DD_TAGS=env:localdev
      - DD_HOSTNAME=local-${USER}
      - DD_SITE=datadoghq.com
      # Required for other container to send metrics, logs, and traces
      - DD_APM_ENABLED=true
      - DD_LOGS_ENABLED=true
      - DD_TRACE_ENABLED=true
      - DD_UNLOAD_MODULES_FROM_SITECUSTOMIZE=true
      - DD_DOGSTATSD_NON_LOCAL_TRAFFIC=true
      # DOCKER COMPOSE value only
      - DD_LOGS_CONFIG_CONTAINER_COLLECT_ALL=true
      - DD_CONTAINER_EXCLUDE_LOGS=name:^(datadog-agent|livekit-server)$
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - /proc/:/host/proc/:ro
      - /opt/datadog-agent/run:/opt/datadog-agent/run:rw
      - /sys/fs/cgroup/:/host/sys/fs/cgroup:ro
    ports:
      - "8125:8125/udp"
      - "8126:8126/tcp"
    restart: unless-stopped
  livekit-server:
    image: livekit/livekit-server:latest
    container_name: livekit-server
    command: --dev --bind 0.0.0.0
    ports:
      - "7880:7880/tcp"
      - "7881:7881/tcp"
      - "7882:7882/udp"
    healthcheck:
      # language=sh
      test: wget --no-verbose --spider --tries=1 http://localhost:7880 || exit 1
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped
  voice-agent:
    build: .
    container_name: voice-agent
    env_file:
      # Loading secret from *.env refer to envs/ and use `make inject-env-locally`
      # to generate .env from envs/*.env
      # ex: DD_API_KEY
      - .env
    environment:
      # Non-secret configuration
      # Leverage default configuration from docker file.
      - AGENT_ENV=local
      - LIVEKIT_URL=ws://livekit-server:7880
      - DD_AGENT_HOST=datadog-agent
      - DD_SERVICE=voice-agent
      # Can override them here if need to
      - DD_ENV=localdev
    command: run_voice_agent --log-level DEBUG
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - datadog-agent
      - livekit-server
